About Manzil Homes

What is Manzil Homes?

Manzil Homes (Manzil Constructions & Interiors) is a women-led luxury interior design and construction company based in Visakhapatnam, serving Vizag, Hyderabad and all of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

Where is your office?

10/326/1, Vishalakshi Nagar, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530040. We are open all days, 9am to 7pm.

Who leads Manzil Homes?

Founder and CEO Shaik Miza Mehroz, a Civil Engineer and Interior Designer (B.E. Civil Engineering and M.Tech Structural Engineering, Andhra University) with over five years in design and interiors.

Which areas do you serve?

Visakhapatnam (including MVP Colony, Madhurawada, Rushikonda and Seethammadhara), Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Guntur, Amaravati, Rajahmundry, Kakinada, Tirupati, Warangal and other parts of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

How do I contact you?

Call or WhatsApp +91 94920 54954, email manzil.homes24@gmail.com, or use the contact form on our website.

Services

What services do you offer?

Luxury home interiors, house and villa construction, renovation, modular kitchens, wardrobes, theme-based interiors, 3D visualization, and office, café and showroom interiors.

Do you do both construction and interiors?

Yes. We are a design-build company, so one team handles architecture, construction and interiors.

Do you design single rooms?

Yes. We design complete homes or individual rooms such as a kitchen, living room or bedroom.

Do you design offices and cafés?

Yes. We design offices, cafés, restaurants and showrooms.

Do you renovate old homes?

Yes. We start with a structural and services check and then plan the renovation.

Design

Are your designs Vastu compliant?

Yes. Vastu inputs are part of the first discussion and built into every layout.

Will I see 3D designs?

Yes. We share photo-realistic 3D renders before execution.

Can you design in a traditional style?

Yes. We design modern, traditional, theme-based and artistic interiors.

Can I choose my own materials?

Yes. You choose materials and finishes with our team, ideally with physical samples at our studio.

Do you design for coastal climates?

Yes. In Vizag and other coastal cities we use moisture- and corrosion-resistant materials and plan ventilation.

Cost and payments

How much do interiors cost?

It depends on scope, size, materials, finishes and hardware. We share a detailed BOQ after understanding your home. See our guide to interior cost factors.

Is there a free consultation?

Yes. The first consultation is free.

Are there hidden costs?

No. We work with a transparent BOQ and track every variation.

Do you give an itemised quote?

Yes. Every item and specification is listed in the BOQ.

Timeline and execution

How long does a project take?

It depends on scope and decisions. We agree a milestone-based schedule at the start of every project.

Do you deliver on time?

We plan with milestone-based schedules and keep you updated at every stage.

Do you work in gated communities?

Yes. We plan logistics and working hours around society rules.

What happens after handover?

We walk through the home with you, check every fitting, and provide after-care.
